name: DFV Deutsche Familienversicherung AG
summary: DFV Deutsche Familienversicherung AG is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm provides its services to Institutional and private investors. It focuses primarily on selling insurance policies digitally and online. The firm is engaged in digital Insurtech and insurance sector. It offers the broad range of digital customer solutions. Its product portfolio includes supplemental health insurance policies. DFV Deutsche Familienversicherung AG was founded in 2006 and is based Frankfurt, Germany.
